QUOTE: On a `CHANNEL_DELETED` websocket event (archive), if archived channels are not viewable, the app kicks the user out of the channel if it is current (`handleKickFromChannel`, `Events.CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`) and removes the user from the channel. If viewable, the channel is kept and only its `delete_at` is set.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a non-viewable setting removes the user and kicks them out if the channel is current, and that a viewable setting keeps the channel and sets `delete_at`, which marks it deleted.
